item.title: U.S. and Iran close to "peace arrangement or a deal," Pakistan says
item.description: The U.S. and Iran are close to agreeing on "some sort of arrangement," Pakistan's defense minister told Bloomberg on Tuesday.

item.title: What to know about today's total solar eclipse
item.description: The only total solar eclipse of 2026 will cross the Northern Hemisphere on Wednesday, Aug. 12, with a path of totality across parts of Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain. See when and where it will be visible.

item.title: Sen. Klobuchar projected winner of DFL primary in Minnesota governor's race
item.description: CBS News projects Sen. Amy Klobuchar, the heavy favorite, will win the Democratic primary in Minnesota's gubernatorial race and will face the Republican challenger in November.

item.title: Ilhan Omar projected winner of Democratic primary in Minnesota's 5th district
item.description: Minnesota Congresswoman Ilhan Omar has secured the Democratic nomination for reelection in the 2026 primary, CBS News projects.

item.title: Peggy Flanagan projected winner of Democratic primary for Senate in Minnesota
item.description: Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan has captured the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in the Minnesota primary election, CBS News projects.

item.title: Lisa Demuth projected winner of Republican primary in Minnesota governor's race
item.description: Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth will win the Republican primary in Minnesota's gubernatorial race, CBS News projects.

item.title: Powerful storms slam Midwest, leave nearly 1 million without power
item.description: Nearly 1 million customers in the Midwest were without power as perilous thunderstorms and extreme wind gusts pummeled the region on Tuesday.

item.title: 14-term Rep. John Larson ousted by challenger in Connecticut Democratic primary
item.description: Democratic Rep. John Larson — who has represented central Connecticut since the late 1990s — lost his party's primary Tuesday to former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin, CBS News has projected.

item.title: Dems pick nominees in key Wisc. districts as Sean Duffy's son-in-law wins GOP primary
item.description: National Democrats see two Wisconsin districts currently held by Republicans as up for grabs in November — the 1st and 3rd Districts. Here's how the primaries are shaping up.

item.title: Tafoya projected winner of GOP nomination for Senate in Minnesota primary
item.description: Michele Tafoya, a former television sports reporter, is the winner of the Republican nomination for Senate in the Minnesota primary election, CBS News projects.

item.title: Wisconsin's Democratic showdown and more primary races to watch today
item.description: South Carolina Republicans will choose a successor for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham's seat, and Minnesota's Senate primary is another battle between moderate and progressive Democrats.

item.title: Trump-backed candidate wins crowded GOP primary in Alabama's new 2nd District
item.description: Rhett Marques will take on Democratic Rep. Shomari Figures in the newly drawn district that's more favorable to Republicans.

item.title: Trump secretly switched to different plane in Turkey amid Iran threat
item.description: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

item.title: California high-speed rail could run out of money by December 2027, as authority cuts train order in half
item.description: The watchdog's review warns the $4 billion federal funding loss now leaves the project needing billions in financing within 16 months — as the rail authority acknowledges for the first time that it still has no train contract, has cut its order from six trains to three, and has dropped the "Buy America" requirement.

item.title: High school football player finds venomous snake inside helmet he was wearing
item.description: The Maumelle High football player wore the helmet for nearly an hour and was fortunate he wasn't bitten, animal services director Chris Davis said.

item.title: Darline Graham, Ralph Norman advance to runoff in South Carolina GOP Senate primary
item.description: Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman will face off in a runoff later this month for the South Carolina GOP Senate nomination, CBS News projects, as they vie to replace the late Sen. Lindsey Graham.

item.title: ICE plans to give officers gloves that can deliver electric shocks
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers may soon be outfitted with gloves that can deliver painful electric shocks that are intended to gain compliance from combative individuals.

item.title: Timeline of Trump's secret plane switch in Turkey amid Iran threat
item.description: A U.S. official confirmed Tuesday that President Trump was secretly removed from Air Force One and switched to a different plane following a credible threat from Iran as he left the NATO summit in Turkey last month. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi and Natalie Brand have more.

item.title: Beach town mayor worries social media trend could lead to shark attack
item.description: Bay Head Mayor Bill Curtis worries that baiting sharks close to shore in order to take pictures and videos of them could be a recipe for disaster.

item.title: Analysis of key primary races in Minnesota, Wisconsin, South Carolina and more
item.description: CBS News political director Fin Gómez breaks down some of the key primary races unfolding on Tuesday as voters cast ballots in Minnesota, Wisconsin, Alabama, Connecticut, Vermont and South Carolina.

item.title: Rescuers race to find Colombia earthquake survivors as death toll rises
item.description: Over 1,100 homes were destroyed when Colombia was struck by its strongest earthquake on record.

item.title: What's at stake as voters cast ballots in six primaries, including South Carolina and Wisconsin
item.description: Primary elections are being held Tuesday in six states: Wisconsin, Minnesota, Alabama, Connecticut, Vermont and South Carolina. CBS News' Taurean Small, Jonah Kaplan, Mark Strassmann and Anthony Salvanto have the latest.

item.title: U.S. military operations killed 153 civilians last year, Pentagon says
item.description: The Pentagon has acknowledged that U.S. military operations killed more than 150 civilians in 2025. The count did not include any deaths from airstrikes on boats in the Caribbean Sea and Pacific Ocean.

item.title: White House asked DOJ about new Reflecting Pool case against David Hearn
item.description: Earlier this month, however, federal prosecutors moved to dismiss the case, citing new information that the damage was caused by a "botched installation" by a contractor, not vandalism.

item.title: Trump administration bars use of Medicaid funds for some youth transgender care
item.description: Medicaid said it won't pay for gender-affirming surgeries or hormones for transgender minors.

item.title: 8/11: CBS Evening News
item.description: President Trump took secret flight out of July's NATO summit due to Iranian missile threat; storms hit Midwest as wildfires rage in western states.

item.title: Play video games? You, too, could become an air traffic controller
item.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy is touting the success of a campaign targeting video gamers to train as air traffic controllers.

item.title: Social Security adds 14 conditions to fast-track disability list
item.description: The Social Security Administration is expanding its list of diseases and other health conditions that may qualify for accelerated approval of disability benefits.

item.title: U.S. Marine veteran freed from Russian prison after nearly 4 years
item.description: A U.S. Marine veteran from Massachusetts who has been held in Russia for more than four years on disputed charges has been released.

item.title: What's behind the $4B funding cut for California's high-speed rail?
item.description: Records reveal California twice missed deadlines to buy the trains at the center of a federal funding fight — then quietly dropped its lawsuit weeks after missing its new deadline.
